data.overview: A young game warden arrests a legendary poacher and learns that his prisoner knows where a fortune lies beneath a frozen lake. When crooked officers and armed thieves descend, the pair must cross the cracking ice before spring turns it into open water.
data.tagline: Trust is the only thing that won't crack.
data.title: Thin Ice Run
